title: Guarantee Calculation Sheet: On-Time Credit for a Late Factory Production Order
content:
A late shipment of Factory Production Orders in a build class that carries the on-time guarantee earns a credit fixed by four quantities.

**Benchmark date.** Lateness is measured from the guarantee benchmark date, which is the later of the committed ship date and the latest revised ship date among the order's delay notices whose cause is customer hold, late acknowledgment, customer specification remake or weather and freight.

**Grace period.** The grace period ends the class guarantee grace business days after the benchmark date, counted starting the day after the benchmark date, Monday through Friday excluding U.S. federal holidays.

**Full weeks late.** The full weeks late are the calendar days from the end of the grace period to the order's ship date, divided by seven and rounded down; shipping on or before the end of the grace period earns nothing.

**Credit.** The credit is the class credit per unit per week times the units on the order times the full weeks late, never more than the class cap per order, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| committed ship date, ship date (date the last unit shipped), units on the order | the factory order record |
| delay notices and their revised ship dates | the order's milestone records |
| grace business days, credit per unit per week, cap per order | the order's build class |

## Worked examples (hypothetical, no federal holiday in the period)

- A Custom Size Build order of 4 units has a committed ship date on a Friday and no delay notice of an excluded cause, so the benchmark is that Friday. The 5-business-day grace period ends the following Friday. The order ships 10 calendar days after that: 10 divided by 7, rounded down, is 1 full week. The credit is 25.00 for each of 4 units for 1 week, 100.00.
- The same order with 8 units shipping 17 calendar days after the end of grace: 2 full weeks, 25.00 for each of 8 units for 2 weeks is 400.00, held to the 250.00 class cap: 250.00.
- Shipping 6 calendar days after the end of grace gives 0 full weeks; nothing is earned.
